name: Pallas: A JAX kernel DSL
notes: Pallas is a JAX kernel DSL for writing custom TPU and GPU kernels. Provides a programming model for writing high-performance kernels in JAX. NOTE: The original URL (github.com/jax-ml/jax/blob/main/jax/experimental/pallas/README.md) returns 404 - the file has been moved. The Pallas documentation is now at docs.jax.dev.
